# 2 Samuel Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 197r–198v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_024_page_001.jpg, 2SA_024_page_002.jpg

---

**24:1** And-again [the]-anger [af] of-YHWH burned [charah] against-Yisra'el, and-he-incited [vayyaset] David against-them, saying, "Go, count [meneh] Yisra'el and-Yehudah."

**24:2** And-said the-king to Yo'av, [the]-commander of-the-army [sar ha-chayil] who [was]-with-him, "Go-about, please, through-all [the]-tribes [shivtey] of-Yisra'el, from-Dan and-unto Beer-Sheva, and-count [piqdu] the-people, and-I-will-know the-number [mispar] of-the-people."

**24:3** And-said Yo'av to the-king, "And-may-YHWH your-God add to-the-people, like-them and-like-them a-hundred-fold, and-[may]-the-eyes of-my-lord the-king [be]-seeing. And-why does-my-lord the-king desire [chafets] this thing?"

**24:4** And-was-strong [vayechezeq] the-word of-the-king over Yo'av and-over [the]-commanders of-the-army. And-went-out Yo'av and-[the]-commanders of-the-army from-before the-king, to-count the-people Yisra'el.

**24:5** And-they-crossed the-Yarden and-camped in-Aro'er, to-[the]-right of-the-city that [is] in-[the]-midst of-[the]-wadi of-Gad, and-toward Ya'zer.

**24:6** And-they-came to-the-Gil'ad and-to-[the]-land of-Tachtim-Chodshi, and-they-came to-Dan-Ya'an and-around to-Tsidon.

**24:7** And-they-came to-[the]-fortress of-Tsor [Tyre] and-all [the]-cities of-the-Chivvi and-the-Kena'ani, and-they-went-out to-[the]-south of-Yehudah, to-Beer-Sheva.

**24:8** And-they-went-about through-all the-land and-came at-[the]-end of-nine months and-twenty days to-Yerushalayim.

**24:9** And-gave Yo'av the-number [mispar] of-[the]-census [mifqad] of-the-people to the-king. And-was Yisra'el eight-hundred thousand men of-valor [ish-chayil] drawing [the]-sword, and-[the]-men of-Yehudah five-hundred thousand men.

**24:10** And-struck [the]-heart [lev] of-David him after so he-had-counted the-people. And-said David to YHWH, "I-have-sinned [chatati] greatly [me'od] [in]-what I-have-done. And-now, YHWH, cause-to-pass [ha'aver], please, the-iniquity ['avon] of-your-servant, for I-have-been-very-foolish [niskalti me'od]."

**24:11** And-rose David in-the-morning, and-[the]-word of-YHWH was to Gad the-prophet [navi], seer [chozeh] of-David, saying,

**24:12** "Go and-speak to David, 'Thus says YHWH: Three [things] I-am-laying [noteh] upon-you; choose for-yourself one of-them, and-I-will-do [it] to-you.'"

**24:13** And-came Gad to David and-told him and-said to-him, "Shall-come to-you seven years of-famine [ra'av] in-your-land? Or three months of-your-fleeing [nuskha] before your-enemies and-he pursuing-you? Or shall-there-be three days of-pestilence [dever] in-your-land? Now know and-see what word I-shall-return to-my-sender."

**24:14** And-said David to Gad, "I-am-in-great-distress [tsar-li me'od]. Let-us-fall, please, into-[the]-hand of-YHWH, for great [rabbim] [are]-his-mercies [rachamav]; but-into-[the]-hand of-man let-me-not fall."

**24:15** And-gave YHWH a-pestilence [dever] in-Yisra'el from-the-morning and-until [the]-time appointed [moed]. And-died from the-people, from-Dan and-unto Beer-Sheva, seventy thousand men.

**24:16** And-stretched-out [vayyishlach] the-angel [mal'akh] his-hand to Yerushalayim to-destroy-it [leshachitah], and-relented [vayyinnachem] YHWH concerning-the-evil [ha-ra'ah], and-said to-the-angel the-one-destroying [ha-mashchit] among-the-people, "Enough [rav]! Now withdraw [heref] your-hand." And-[the]-angel of-YHWH was by [the]-threshing-floor [goren] of-Aravnah [Araunah] the-Yevusi.

**24:17** And-said David to YHWH when-he-saw the-angel the-one-striking [ha-makkeh] the-people, and-he-said, "Behold, I have-sinned [chatati] and-I have-done-wrong [he'eveyti]. And-these, the-flock [ha-tson] — what have-they-done? Let-be, please, your-hand against-me and-against-[the]-house of-my-father."

**24:18** And-came Gad to David on-that day and-said to-him, "Go-up, raise [haqem] to-YHWH an-altar [mizbe'ach] on-[the]-threshing-floor of-Aravnah the-Yevusi."

**24:19** And-went-up David according-to-[the]-word of-Gad, as YHWH commanded.

**24:20** And-looked-out [vayyashqef] Aravnah and-saw the-king and-his-servants crossing over-him. And-went-out Aravnah and-bowed-down to-the-king, his-face to-the-ground.

**24:21** And-said Aravnah, "Why has-come my-lord the-king to his-servant?" And-said David, "To-buy [liqnot] from-you the-threshing-floor, to-build an-altar to-YHWH, and-the-plague [magefah] will-be-restrained [te'atser] from-upon the-people."

**24:22** And-said Aravnah to David, "Let-take and-let-offer-up [ya'al] my-lord the-king the-good in-his-eyes. See, the-cattle [baqar] for-the-burnt-offering [olah], and-the-threshing-sledges [morigim] and-the-yokes [keliy] of-the-cattle for-the-wood."

**24:23** The-whole [ha-kol] Aravnah gave, the-king, to-the-king. And-said Aravnah to the-king, "YHWH your-God accept-you [yirtsekha]."

**24:24** And-said the-king to Aravnah, "No, for buying I-will-buy [qanoh eqneh] from-you at-a-price [bimchir], and-I-will-not offer-up to-YHWH my-God burnt-offerings [olot] [that-cost]-nothing [chinnam]." And-bought David the-threshing-floor and-the-cattle for-silver — fifty shekels.

**24:25** And-built David there an-altar to-YHWH, and-offered-up burnt-offerings [olot] and-peace-offerings [shelamim]. And-was-entreated [vaye'ater] YHWH for-the-land, and-was-restrained [te'atser] the-plague from-upon Yisra'el.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — vayyaset:** "And he incited" — the subject is ambiguous. The MT reads "the anger of YHWH burned... and he incited David against them." The "he" grammatically refers to YHWH. The parallel in 1 Chr 21:1 reads "and Satan stood against Israel and incited David." This is one of the most discussed theological variants in the Hebrew Bible — the same action attributed to YHWH in Samuel and to Satan in Chronicles.

**v.9 — census numbers:** 2 Sam 24:9 gives 800,000 for Israel and 500,000 for Judah. 1 Chr 21:5 gives 1,100,000 for Israel and 470,000 for Judah. The discrepancies are significant and long discussed.

**v.13 — seven vs. three years:** The MT reads "seven years of famine," but the LXX and 1 Chr 21:12 read "three years." The number three would create a symmetrical triad (three years, three months, three days). The LC clearly reads שֶׁבַע ("seven").

**v.14 — rachamav:** "His mercies" — the root רחם is connected to the womb (*rechem*). God's mercy is visceral, maternal compassion. David chooses to fall into the hands of a God whose compassion is womb-deep rather than into the hands of men.

**v.16 — vayyinnachem:** "And YHWH relented" — the root נחם means to feel grief, to change one's mind, to comfort oneself. When applied to God, it expresses divine responsiveness: YHWH is not a static force but a personal being who can be grieved and can relent.

**v.24 — qanoh eqneh / chinnam:** The infinitive absolute "buying I will buy" emphasizes David's insistence. The word *chinnam* ("for nothing/freely") is the same word used in Job 1:9 when Satan asks "Does Job fear God *chinnam*?" David will not offer God something that costs him nothing — a profound principle of worship.

**v.25 — the threshing floor:** This threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite becomes the site of Solomon's temple (2 Chr 3:1). The place where the plague was stopped becomes the place of ongoing atonement. Jewish tradition identifies it with Mount Moriah (Gen 22:2).

*— EMET*
